embedvideo-description: Noocan la faracay wuxuu ku daraa shaqo falanqayn oo lagu dhex gelin karo muuqaallo laga soo qaado ilo caan ah.
embedvideo-consent-privacy-notice-text: $1 waxaa laga yaabaa inuu ururiyo xog shakhsiyeed.
embedvideo-error-missingparams: EmbedVideo waxaa ka maqan halbeeg loo baahan yahay.
embedvideo-error-id: EmbedVideo wuxuu helay aqoonsi khaldan "$2" oo loogu talagalay adeegga "$1".
embedvideo-error-width: EmbedVideo wuxuu helay halbeeg ballac oo khaldan "$1".
embedvideo-error-height: EmbedVideo wuxuu helay halbeeg dherer oo khaldan "$1".
embedvideo-error-alignment: EmbedVideo waxaa la siiyay qiime aan sharci ahayn oo loogu talagalay halbeegga isku toosinta "$1". Qiimayaasha saxda ah waa "left", "center", ama "right".
embedvideo-error-valignment: EmbedVideo waxaa la siiyay qiime aan sharci ahayn oo loogu talagalay halbeegga isku toosinta toosan "$1". Qiimayaasha saxda ah waa "top", "middle", "bottom", ama "baseline".
embedvideo-error-urlargs: EmbedVideo wuxuu helay liis halbeegyo URL ah oo ay ku jiraan xog qaab daran ama halbeegyo madhan.
embedvideo-error-unknown: EmbedVideo wuxuu la kulmay khalad aan la garanayn isagoo isku dayaya inuu abuuro qaybta dhex gelinta fiidiyowgan. ($1)
embedvideo-error-evp_deprecated: Shaqada falanqaynta #evp waa laga joojiyey EmbedVideo 2.0. Fadlan u beddel summadda shaqada falanqaynta #ev.
embedvideo-error-container: Halbeegga loo bixiyey 'container' waa mid aan sax ahayn.
apihelp-embedvideo-summary: Hel koodhka dhex gelinta fiidiyowga ee la soo saaray iyadoo lagu salaynayo halbeegyada la bixiyay.
apihelp-embedvideo-param-dimensions: Ama ballac tiro ah (100) ama ballac iyo dherer (100x100)
apihelp-embedvideo-param-container: Aqbal frame, ama madhan ka tag
apihelp-embedvideo-param-urlargs: Halbeegyo dheeraad ah oo lagu darayo URL-ka fiidiyowga (adeegyada qaarkood)
apihelp-embedvideo-param-autoresize: Si otomaatig ah dib loogu cabbiro muuqaalka? (run ama been)
